name: Nayan Rabadiya
affiliation: M.TECH COMPUTER SCIENCE & ENGINEERING · IIT DELHI · NEW DELHI
lede: I build things close to the machine and measure them honestly — query engines under a hard memory budget, vectorised and GPU kernels, language runtimes, and machine learning on physiological signals that has to survive real-world noise.
intro: My M.Tech thesis at IIT Delhi detects atrial fibrillation from photoplethysmography (PPG) recorded by smartwatches and armbands, aiming at a low false-alarm rate so continuous rhythm monitoring stays usable outside the clinic. Alongside it I work on systems performance — SIMD and CUDA acceleration, MPI-distributed search, out-of-core query execution — and I am currently ranked first in the department.

currently.text: Training and evaluating PPG-only AF classifiers on beat-level labels transferred from synchronised ECG, across the AIIMS and VitalDB cohorts.

meta_description: Nayan Rabadiya — M.Tech Computer Science & Engineering, IIT Delhi (department rank 1). Thesis on atrial fibrillation detection from PPG signals in wearable devices. Systems, high-performance computing and applied machine learning.
